titre: Devoir de contrôle n°3 - Anglais (3ème année secondaire)

exercices.enonce:
TEXT
Every year, thousands of young people leave the countryside to move to big cities, hoping for a better life. This phenomenon, called rural exodus, has important consequences. In the cities, young people hope to find jobs, good schools and modern entertainment. However, the reality is often disappointing. Cities become overcrowded, houses become expensive, and many newcomers end up unemployed and living in poor neighbourhoods. At the same time, the countryside loses its young population and its lands are abandoned. To solve this problem, governments should develop rural areas by building schools, hospitals and factories there, and by supporting agriculture. If life in the countryside becomes attractive, young people will no longer feel forced to leave their villages.

I. READING COMPREHENSION (8 marks)
1) What phenomenon does the text describe?   (2 marks)
2) Why do young people move to big cities?   (2 marks)
3) What problems do the cities and the countryside face because of this?   (2 marks)
4) What solutions does the writer propose?   (2 marks)

II. LANGUAGE (6 marks)
1) Complete the first conditional: If life in the countryside becomes attractive, young people ______ (not leave) their villages.   (1,5 marks)
2) Complete with "should": Governments ______ develop rural areas.   (1,5 marks)
3) Give the comparative: Houses in the city are ______ (expensive) than in the countryside.   (1,5 marks)
4) Give the opposite of "abandon" = ______.   (1,5 marks)

III. WRITING (6 marks)
"How can we make rural areas more attractive for young people?" Write a paragraph (about 10 lines) proposing solutions, with examples. Use "should" and linkers.
